name: PayGate

sources.quote: Les API de collecte (cash in) sont accessibles à tout le monde c’est-à-dire particulier et entreprise,
Carte Formalités des Entreprises ou Carte d'Immatriculation Fiscale, Carte d'Identité du Promoteur, Descriptif du Projet, Contact, Lien de retour

open_questions: PayGate's terms (https://paygateglobal.com/cgu) say the collection APIs are open to 'particulier et entreprise' (§ B.1.2) but list an RCCM number among the eligibility conditions for merchants in Togo (§ B.2), and the FAQ on https://paygateglobal.com asks for a 'Carte Formalités des Entreprises ou Carte d'Immatriculation Fiscale' to activate the account. Whether an individual without an RCCM can open a merchant account is unclear.

description: PayGate is a Togolese payment gateway for collecting mobile money payments and disbursing funds via Mixx Togo (T-Money) and Moov (Flooz). API documentation is private and only accessible to authenticated merchants from their PayGate dashboard.
example_prompt: Add PayGate to my Togolese app so I can collect mobile money payments via T-Money and Flooz, and disburse funds to mobile money numbers.
